# HireWire
> Free, privacy-first job-search tool that aggregates 38+ public job feeds,
> scores postings against the user's own profile, and tracks the application
> pipeline. Runs entirely in the browser — no account, no server-side data,
> CV never uploaded anywhere.

## Pages
- [Guide & FAQ](https://hirewire.fyi/guide.html): how it works, who it's for, comparison vs spreadsheets, privacy model
- [App](https://hirewire.fyi/): the tool itself (requires JavaScript)
